releases.body:
**Experimental mod only for testing!**

Main feature of this mod is ability to use **box32**. 
If **WoW64** mode is enabled, WoW64 Wine is used (default).
If **WoW64** mode is disabled, the regular bi-arch Wine is used with the **box32** feature. For now, some x86 OpenGL games work in **box32** mode with higher performance than in WoW64 mode.

Other features:
- Built-in custom **frame generation** (_Screen effects -> Frame generation_).
- Support of **Russian** input (Unicode) from the on-screen keyboard.
- **Freedreno** OpenGL driver, **LLVMPipe** driver.
- Optional **Lorie X-server**.
- **Old VirGL** test server with better compatibility.

It is recommended to _disable WoW64_ mode with **VirGL** for better performance.

**Changes:**
- Added **vkBasalt** sharpness effects for shortcuts (from Winlator Bionic).
- Upgraded **Frame generation**: improved _motion estimation_, added _FPS multiplier_ (x2, x3, x4), added _Motion scale_, _Blending_ and _Post-processing_ adjustments, added _Engine_ options (DIS, QCOM, GLES).
1. _QCOM_ frame generation engine uses more fast and accurate hardware _GL_QCOM_motion_estimation_ (modern Adreno only).

releases.name: ares v148
releases.body:
ares v148 has now been released.

This release includes big improvements to a number of ares cores. Highlights include rewrites to the N64 CPU & RSP JITs resulting in significant performance gains across the N64 library, additional implementation & accuracy improvements to the PlayStation core, fixes to the GBA core, and support for the Famicom data recorder & Dendy. 

Additionally, there have been many updates to the core ares application across all platforms. Per-core input configuration has been added, updated video, audio, & input drivers are available, bug fixes, additional options have been added, and core dependencies have been updated. 

Since v147, 20 contributors have created 300 commits to the ares codebase.

As always, if you wish to see the full changelog in a per-commit format along with their authors, you can do so on GitHub [here](https://github.com/ares-emulator/ares/compare/v147...v148).

As always, if you wish to see the full changelog in a per-commit format along with their authors, you can do so on GitHub [here](https://github.com/ares-emulator/ares/compare/v144...v145).

- Implemented many undocumented instruction encodings
- Implemented invalid CPSR modes
- Added support for MRC, MCR, and CDP coprocessor instructions
- Allowed misalignment of the program counter in ARM mode

**Nintendo - Game Boy Color**

- Improved HDMA and GDMA timings (fixes some major graphical bugs)

**Nintendo - Game Boy Advance**

- Added support for the Real Time Clock
- Re-introduced optional Game Boy Player support

releases.name: Borked3DS v2025.01.23
releases.body:
This release features many experimental/WIP Android improvements by @kleidis that you can test before they eventually get merged into [Azahar](https://github.com/azahar-emu/azahar). It also brings up various third-party dependencies to their latest major versions, and includes some very minor bug fixes.

There is also [a beta release](https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/releases/tag/v2025.01.23-sdl-compat) that is the same as this one except that it incorporates the use of SDL3 via the SDL2 compatability layer. The intent is to port this project over to pure SDL3 eventually, but the compatability layer approach allows people to play around with things while waiting for the porting to be completed. This also gives this project a fallback in case SDL2 stops being supported upstream but new functionality such as gamepad support for new game controllers continues to be updated on the SDL3 branch.

### What's Changed
* Android: Some minor fixes by @rtiangha in https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/pull/293
* renderer_opengl: Enable a couple of optimizations by @rtiangha in https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/pull/294

# FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE · Android 原生移植版 v1.1.0 发布说明

- **版本号**：`v1.1.0`（`versionCode=80`，`org.ffrs.gamewindow`）
- **通用安装包**：`FFRS-1.1.0-universal.apk`（`arm64-v8a`，全平台通用）

---

## 本版本主要更新

### 1. 通用性能优化（骁龙 / 天玑全平台适用）
- **描述符与同步热路径优化**：新增图形 `PushMemo` 负载缓存、`PushMemoTexel` 原地刷新与 `SlotSets` 惰性分配，大幅降低重复描述符构建开销；扩大 `push_memo_map` 容量上限至 `32768`，避免复杂大场景频繁整表清空。
- **瞬态着色器自适应旁路**：新增 `PushMemoShaderState` 机制，自动识别连续未命中的瞬态着色器并临时旁路查表，减少无效哈希计算。
- **屏障与状态查询精简**：收窄 `texel` 与 `compute_barrier()` 管线屏障，合并 `pending_view()` 单趟重叠检查，缓存 `VkFormatProperties3` 并跳过只读纹理的重复 `prepare_read`。
- **洞窟场景闪烁修复**：修复洞窟路段左右移动时偶发的右半屏隔帧闪烁问题，保持全场景画面完整稳定输出。

### 2. 完整内置功能
- **画质与帧率设置**（顶部菜单 `≡` → **画质与帧率**）：
  - **帧率上限**：支持 `沿用原设置 / 30 FPS / 40 FPS / 60 FPS`，调节后实时生效，无需重启。
  - **画面输出档位**：支持 `沿用原设置 / 720p 输出 / 1080p 输出`，保存并重开游戏后生效。
- **内置中文金手指**（顶部菜单 `≡` → **金手指**，勾选保存并重启生效）：
  - 移动速度 2 倍
  - 不遇敌（按住 R3 临时恢复正常）
  - 战斗掉落率 100%
  - 战斗经验值 2 倍
  - 战斗金币 2 倍
  - 角色存档修改

### 3. 虚拟手柄默认布局优化
- 缩小肩键（`L1/L2/R1/R2`）与功能键（`- / +`）尺寸，将肩键下移至左右中侧边缘，避免遮挡左上角帧率/任务信息与右上角小地图。
- 对称对齐左右摇杆、`L3/R3`、十字键与 `A/B/X/Y` 菱形按键间距，默认布局更紧凑清晰（仍支持在「编辑按键布局」中自由微调或重置）。

---

## 安装与使用提示
- 请确保设备存储根目录已放置合法导出的游戏数据目录 `/sdcard/FFRS`。

# Let's Go Launcher 0.3

This is the third release of Let's Go Launcher. It brings the game from barely playable on Mali to a real frame rate on weak devices, and fixes the boot failure that stopped the game from opening on some phones.

## Measured performance (Galaxy S20+, Mali-G77, heavy scene)

- **~13.6 fps → 16–20 fps, average ~17.6, peak 20.1** (measured over a 73-second session in the heavy scene; the previous build averaged ~13.6 fps there)
- The game is now GPU-bound (~96% GPU busy, ~23% CPU) — the CPU is no longer the wall
- With a warm pipeline cache, indoor battles reached 23–26 fps
- No crashes in the test session

## What's new in 0.3

- **Boots where it didn't before** — the guest memory base moved from 0x60 to 0x50 (v0132), fixing the launch failure on devices where that range is occupied
- **Log viewer works on HarmonyOS** — when logcat returns nothing, "Ver log" now reads the log file the runtime writes (fix for issue #15)

releases.body:
# Let's Go Launcher 0.2

This is the second release of Let's Go Launcher. More modifications are coming — this is just the beginning.

## What it is

Let's Go Launcher is an Android port of Pokémon Let's Go Eevee, based on letsgo-recomp. It runs the game natively on Android and includes:

- Its own NSP importer — import the game from your own NSP dump. The import runs as a foreground service, and if an import is interrupted, the data file is verified and rebuilt automatically.
- Data pack import — import a ready-made data pack (zip) instead of an NSP.
- Turnip drivers — install and try community Turnip Vulkan drivers, with automatic rollback if a driver fails.
- Touch controls and physical controllers — play with the on-screen controls or a connected gamepad.

## What's new in 0.2

- **Mali support** — the game now runs on Mali GPUs (Galaxy S20+ and other Exynos devices). The Vulkan runtime falls back to render passes when dynamic rendering is unavailable, uses EXT dynamic state, and decodes BC7/BC6H textures on the CPU when the GPU can't sample them. Characters and the world now render with full textures on Mali.

- Its own NSP importer — import the game from your own NSP dump. The import runs as a foreground service, and if an import is interrupted, the data file is verified and rebuilt automatically.
- Data pack import — import a ready-made data pack (zip) instead of an NSP.
- Turnip drivers — install and try community Turnip Vulkan drivers, with automatic rollback if a driver fails.
- Touch controls and physical controllers — play with the on-screen controls or a connected gamepad.

## Mods, right in the interface

The launcher has a Mods screen: load mod packs (zip, rar, 7z) directly from the interface, with no manual file editing, and browse the GameBanana catalog to find mods.

## Gyroscope

Gyro aiming is supported (GyroAim): aim by moving your phone or your controller.

## Port created by CowKillers and ptichalouf

This port was created by CowKillers and ptichalouf — equal creators of the port.

releases.name: Winlator CMOD 11.2 Fix 3 - Flyme/Android 16 反孤儿 Subreaper 根治、手柄修复与开始菜单汉化
releases.body:
## 核心变更

### 1. Flyme 12.6 / Android 16 反孤儿进程根治（`libsubreaper.so`）
- 经魅族 21 Note（Flyme 12.6 / Android 16）控制变量实测，系统会在 `< 100ms` 内静默终止普通应用 UID 下托孤给 `init`（`PPID=1`）的孤儿进程。
- 内置 368 字节纯静态 PIE（`ET_DYN`、64KB 对齐）AArch64 启动器 `lib/arm64-v8a/libsubreaper.so`，通过 `prctl(PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER, 1)` 接管整个 Wine 进程子树并循环 `wait4(-1)` 回收已退出子进程（含 `-EINTR` 重试，兼容暂停/恢复）。
- 通过 `ImageFs.find(Context)` → `ProcessHelper.initNativeLibDir()` → `ProcessHelper.wrapWithSubreaper()` 接入启动链，彻底移除早期写死 `proton-9.0-arm64ec/lib/wine/aarch64-unix/ntdll.so` 的原地二进制补丁与 `wineserver -f -p` 预启动变通方案。
- **实测结果**：使用原版未修改 `ntdll.so` 即可进入容器，`wineserver`、`services.exe`、`winedevice.exe`、`plugplay.exe`、`rpcss.exe`、`explorer.exe` 全程挂载在 `libsubreaper.so` 下存活且零僵尸进程；不再局限于 `proton-9.0-arm64ec`，实测 `proton-9.0-x86_64` 也可正常进入容器。

### 2. 手柄无响应问题修复（虚拟手柄 / XInput）
- `services.exe` 与 `winedevice.exe`（承载 `winebus.sys`、`winehid.sys`、`winexinput.sys`、`libSDL2`、`libfakeinput.so`）在 `wineboot.exe` 退出后不再因成为孤儿被系统击杀，手柄驱动链路保持存活。
- 修正 `WineUtils.changeServicesStatus()` 中正常/精简模式将 `winebus` / `winehid` 设为禁用（`Start=4`）的问题，改为 `Start=3`，并升级配置标记为 `startupSelection_v4` 使旧容器启动时自动修复注册表。

### 3. 注册表与 Wine 开始菜单汉化补齐

- **中文化与中文字体**：完成主要 Android 界面中文化（`values-zh-rCN` / `values-zh` 与主要 Compose 文案），并在容器模板注入文泉驿微米黑字体与 `FontLink` 注册表配置。

- **原发布说明更正**：旧说明中关于“16KB 页表兼容 / Android 16 Bionic FORTIFY `open64`/`fcntl64` 崩溃修复”及“对 `explorer.exe` 实施 5 处指令级免疫补丁”的描述与实际打包产物不符——经后续真机复核，实测机型为标准 4KB 页（`PAGE_SIZE=4096`），APK 内的 `wineserver` 与 `explorer.exe` 均未包含上述二进制补丁。
- **已知问题（已在 `fix3` 中解决）**：
  1. 仅对 `proton-9.0-arm64ec` 有效，其他 Wine/Proton 版本无法进入容器；
  2. `wineboot.exe` 退出后 `services.exe` / `winedevice.exe` 仍会因托孤给 PID 1 被 Flyme 击杀，导致虚拟手柄与实体手柄无响应；
  3. 精简/正常模式下 `winebus` / `winehid` 仍为禁用状态（`Start=4`）；
  4. 游戏库快捷方式路径解析存在崩溃缺陷（已在 `fix2` / `fix3` 修复）。

releases.body:
## Novità per gli amministratori

- **Cambia nome utente**: dalla lista utenti. L'utente viene disconnesso e accede di nuovo con il nuovo nome; salvataggi, console e amici restano invariati.
- **Salvataggi di un giocatore**: per ogni gioco puoi scaricare il salvataggio del giocatore oppure sostituirlo (o crearlo) con un file .sav, anche esportato da DeSmuME o da un altro emulatore. Prima di caricare viene chiesta conferma, con un avviso se le dimensioni non corrispondono al salvataggio attuale. La versione sostituita resta nella cronologia del server, e se il giocatore stava giocando su quella vecchia all'uscita gli viene chiesto quale tenere.

## Altre modifiche

- I dati locali (ROM in cache, copie dei salvataggi, stati salvati) sono legati all'account e non più al nome utente: dopo un cambio di nome restano al loro posto. Alla prima apertura vengono spostati automaticamente.

## Requisiti

Server [nds-server-emulator-fastapi](https://github.com/federico-castellani/nds-server-emulator-fastapi) aggiornato (commit `7d2701c`). Con un server precedente l'app funziona, ma le nuove funzioni di amministrazione non sono disponibili.

**Status:** Playable menus, paddock/garage, and on-track driving on ARM64 Vulkan (`-O3 + ThinLTO`); fixes blown-out bloom / pitch-black 3D scenes caused by `exp_adjust` texture fetch exponent bias and eliminates MSAA resolve log spam.

releases.name: MH Rise port v1.7.0
releases.body:
## Endemic life is visible

Small creatures in the field (Stinkmink, Clothfly and the rest of the endemic life) were invisible in the port: you could still pick them up and get their buffs, but nothing was drawn. The game decides whether to draw them from a visibility test it runs on the GPU and then reads back on the CPU; the port never copied that result back, so the game always read "not visible". Now it does. Only that small result is copied, so the frame rate stays at a locked 30 fps.

- An empty file `sin_devolver_copias` in the game folder brings back the old behaviour.

Thanks to the player who reported it in issue #8.

Nothing else changes: shader caches are the same as in 1.6.0, so your existing caches keep working.

## Installing

Install the APK over the previous version (your settings and saves stay) or follow the [README](https://github.com/IamWilmar/mhrise-recomp#install-and-first-run) for a first install.

releases.name: MH Rise port v1.5.0
releases.body:
## No more blinking objects after loading

While the game is running, each new combination of shader and render state needs a GPU pipeline. Pipelines the app has never seen are built in the background so the game doesn't freeze, and until one is ready the objects that use it are not drawn. Until now that also happened to pipelines it had already built in an earlier session. Only the first 4,000 were prepared at start-up, in the order they first appeared, so later in the game whole areas came from the background again. The result was objects and textures blinking for a few frames after loading a save or when walking into an area.

- Pipelines that the app has already built on your device are now created on the spot, in about a quarter of a millisecond each and within a small per-frame budget, so they are drawn from the first frame.
- Start-up preparation now begins with the pipelines your last session used (`pipelines_recientes.bin` in the game folder), not with the ones from the beginning of the game.
- Areas you visit for the very first time can still show an object a moment late while its pipeline is built. The second visit is clean.

Two new rows in the settings panel (swipe in from the right edge of the screen):

It is a single request, without an account, and nothing about you or your game is sent. If there is a newer version, a banner says so and *Get vX.Y.Z* opens its page. Switch it off in the panel (or create an empty file `sin_avisos_version` in the game folder) and the app makes no network request at all.

releases.body:
# Model 3-Vulkan v0.9.9.8 — Release Notes

**2026-11-14 · Windows x64 · Linux x86_64 · macOS Intel**

Model 3-Vulkan v0.9.9.8 is a performance release. Nothing in the emulation model changed: every
game still renders the same picture it did in v0.9.9.6, and the same save states still load. What
changed is how much work the CPU and the GPU have to do to get there.

The headline is that the hybrid JIT now translates **more than 80 % of the guest instruction
stream to native x86-64**, the Vulkan renderer stopped paying for a redundant depth write that was
silently disabling hardware Early-Z / Hi-Z culling, and UMA GPUs finally get zero-copy geometry
upload. Together those turn the integrated-GPU experience from "lock it to 496×384" into a picture
that can actually be played at native resolution.

## 📦 Packages

| Platform | File | Requirements |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows x64 | `Model3-Vulkan.v0.9.9.8.for.Windows.zip` | Windows 10/11, Vulkan 1.3 |
| Linux x86_64 | `Model3-Vulkan.v0.9.9.8.for.Linux.tar.gz` | glibc 2.38+, Vulkan 1.3 |
| macOS Intel | `Model3-Vulkan.v0.9.9.8.for.macOS-Intel.tar.gz` | macOS 13.0+, bundled MoltenVK 1.3 |

# Model 3-Vulkan v0.9.9.6 — Release Notes

**2026-11-07 · Windows (this download) · Linux / macOS builds from the same tree are produced by CI**

Model 3-Vulkan v0.9.9.6 is the biggest release this fork has shipped. It is not a maintenance
build: the emulation core now has a PowerPC → x86-64 hybrid JIT, the audio path can drive a real

## Why the v0.9.8.6 Windows package refused to start on AMD graphics cards

On Windows, AMD's Vulkan driver reports **128 bytes** of push constants — the amount Vulkan itself
guarantees. Every driver this renderer had been developed against reports 256.

releases.name: v2.5.0
releases.body:
## Highlights

- **Disk images are kept unmodified with a save directory.** With `-saveDir`, what the software writes goes to an overlay file there and the image is only read. Overlays store only the tracks or blocks written and are tied to a checksum of their image. This also makes writable the disks that could not be written before: inside a zip or gzip, loaded from a URL, or embedded in the executable.
- **DOS 3.3 boots in five seconds.** The Disk II motor keeps turning for about a second after the drive is turned off, like the 556 timer of the real controller, and the data latch no longer reads the same nibble twice. DOS no longer waits for the motor on every access: a DOS 3.3 boot takes 5.4 million cycles instead of 36 million.
- **A libretro core** runs izapple2 inside RetroArch and the other libretro frontends, with diskette swapping from M3U playlists and saves as overlays. It is built from source and is not in the release archives. See [the libretro page](https://github.com/ivanizag/izapple2/blob/master/doc/frontend_libretro.md) and [the Mac guide](https://github.com/ivanizag/izapple2/blob/master/doc/frontend_libretro_macos.md).

# Lichii-Enhanced v1.0.0: first public release

Lichii-Enhanced is a fork of [Lichii](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii) focused on usability: easier setup, built-in upscaling, non-destructive modding and more reliable online play. This is the first public release.

> **Platform:** Windows 10/11 x64 only. Distributed as a `.zip` archive. Other platforms are not available yet.

## Highlights

### 🖼️ Built-in upscalers
Upscaling is now part of the renderer; no external injectors or wrappers are needed.

- New post-process stage at the end of the Vulkan frame (compute shaders), running after game rendering and before swapchain presentation
- Filters: Nearest, Bilinear, Bicubic, FSR 1.0 (EASU + RCAS), SGSR
- Configurable render scale and sharpness (RCAS strength)
- Per-game profiles stored in `config/custom/<title-id>.ini`
- Optional anti-aliasing pass before upscaling

releases.body:
**Beta 0.4.0.** Bem menos trabalho de CPU na **Grande Ilha do Céu**, a correção para **celulares de 12 GB** que caíam para menos de 10 fps ([#78](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/78), [#71](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/71)), o fim do **fundo preto nos menus** ([#76](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/76)), o **mapa em tela larga** ([#66](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/66)), a proporção **Esticada** ([#59](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/59)) e várias melhorias para **Mali**.

Atualiza por cima das versões anteriores sem apagar os saves. **Não desinstale o app antes**: isso apaga os saves.

## O que mudou

- **Desempenho na Grande Ilha do Céu:**
  - Os vértices da ilha ficavam fora da área que a GPU lê direto, e a CPU copiava ~2,5 GB a cada 2 s. Agora são ~250 MB, e o trabalho de vértices da thread de render caiu de ~250 para ~75 ms a cada 2 s (POCO F7 Ultra, Turnip).

releases.name: TOTKDroid 0.3.4 (beta): sem queda depois do menu e geração de quadros melhor
releases.body:
**Beta 0.3.4.** Acaba a **queda de fps depois de fechar o inventário** ([#53](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/53), [#24](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/24)) e melhora a **geração de quadros (LSFG)**: importar o `Lossless.dll`, funcionar em mais GPUs Mali e pedir à tela a taxa de atualização que os quadros gerados precisam.

> **Nenhum arquivo do jogo vem junto.** Você precisa do seu próprio dump de *Tears of the Kingdom* com a atualização **1.4.3** aplicada (`exefs` e `romfs`, ou o `romfs` como um único `romfs.bin`).

Atualiza por cima das versões anteriores sem apagar os saves. **Não desinstale o app antes**: isso apaga os saves.

## O que mudou

- **Queda depois do menu ([#53](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/53), [#24](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/24)):**
  - A queda de 12-14 s depois de fechar o inventário, de escolher uma arma ou de salvar não era o clock da GPU, como eu tinha dito.
  - O app desligava o "sync lag" por ~10 s sempre que o jogo saía do mundo, para proteger os carregamentos. Só que ele não distinguia um menu de uma tela de carregamento, e nesses segundos a CPU ficava esperando a GPU.

releases.name: TOTKDroid 0.3.3 (beta): FSR 1 e FXAA mais leves
releases.body:
**Beta 0.3.3.** O **FSR 1** e o **FXAA** ficaram mais leves para a GPU, com a mesma imagem.

> **Nenhum arquivo do jogo vem junto.** Você precisa do seu próprio dump de *Tears of the Kingdom* com a atualização **1.4.3** aplicada (`exefs` e `romfs`, ou o `romfs` como um único `romfs.bin`).

Atualiza por cima das versões anteriores sem apagar os saves. **Não desinstale o app antes**: isso apaga os saves.

## O que mudou

- **FSR 1 (EASU) na metade do tempo:**
  - A análise de borda roda uma vez por pixel, em vez de quatro.
  - Onde não há borda, o pixel sai direto da interpolação bilinear.
  - As contas de cor usam meia precisão, que vira fp16 onde o driver aceita.
  - No POCO F7 Ultra (Adreno 830), o upscale de 1280x717 para 1920x1080 caiu de 1,00 para 0,50 ms por quadro. Não vi diferença nas bordas lado a lado.
  - Ideias do artigo "Optimizing FSR", de atyuwen, reescritas a partir do FSR 1 original.
- **FXAA ~18% mais leve:**
  - Usa meia precisão e o limiar padrão do FXAA 3.11, em vez do "ultra".
  - A busca da borda é mais curta: 5 passos em vez de 10.
  - No POCO caiu de 0,51-0,59 para 0,43-0,44 ms por quadro, sem diferença de serrilhado visível.

releases.name: TOTKDroid 0.3.2 (beta): magenta com Economia de RAM e 2-3 fps na Mali corrigidos
releases.body:
**Beta 0.3.2.** Corrige dois problemas da 0.3.1: os **quadrados magenta com a Economia de RAM ligada** ([#57](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/57)) e a **queda para 2-3 fps no mundo aberto em algumas Mali** (Dimensity 9500, [#41](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/41)).

> **Nenhum arquivo do jogo vem junto.** Você precisa do seu próprio dump de *Tears of the Kingdom* com a atualização **1.4.3** aplicada (`exefs` e `romfs`, ou o `romfs` como um único `romfs.bin`).

Atualiza por cima das versões anteriores sem apagar os saves. **Não desinstale o app antes**: isso apaga os saves.

## O que mudou

- **Quadrados magenta com a Economia de RAM ([#57](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/57)):**
  - A 0.3.1 devolvia ao sistema a memória de cada textura depois de enviá-la à GPU, o que deixava zeros no lugar. O TOTK reaproveita essa memória para criar texturas novas, que então eram enviadas zeradas e apareciam magenta.
  - Isso agora fica desligado. A Economia de RAM continua usando texturas menores e menos memória de cópia.

releases.body:
﻿Android now uses the expanded native CPU corpus by default, including the Spindex microgame callbacks and ROM-backed routines copied into RAM for interrupts, arithmetic, decompression and audio.

- Retains fixed landscape orientation when you turn the phone upside down, while motion controls continue to work.
- Includes the native corpus exercised across all 223 Spindex microgames on desktop: 600 frames each, zero dispatch misses and zero interpreted instructions in those sampled routes.

# STORM 3DS 1.12.0

This release candidate adds experimental support for Nintendo Switch 2 titles, together with stability fixes when stopping a game and an optional GPU path for texture recompression.

**This is a pre-release for testing before v0.1.1.** Feedback and reproducible bug reports are welcome. It includes all improvements from rc1 through rc8.

### What's new since rc8

- **Experimental Switch 2 title support:** per-session hardware profiles with automatic memory sizing, native title loading, the mesh and task shader draw path, and the display path used by these titles.

- **Metal (macOS):** Switch 2 task and mesh draws, and fixes for compute storage buffers.

**This is a pre-release for testing before v0.1.1.** Feedback and reproducible bug reports are welcome. It includes all improvements from rc1 through rc7.

### What's new since rc7

- **Extended cheat instructions:** implemented register comparisons, register save/restore operations and masks, persistent static registers, process pause/resume, and debug logging, with all operand and addressing forms supported by Eden.

- **Cheat files and process targeting:** fixed parsing of names containing Unicode symbols or accents. Memory operations and pause/resume now target the process identified by the cheat metadata, with a cached non-owning process reference.

releases.name: MarathonRecomp-Android v0.3.5.1 Hotfix
releases.body:
This hotfix fixes a frame-rate regression at the 60 FPS cap. On the POCO F5, v0.3.5 requested a 60 Hz display mode and the Vulkan swapchain spent longer waiting for an image. releases.body:
## SkyNetEmu 0.2.4

Source revision: `c57e7f5d7608691bde97bc1c523c22ddf25604c6` (version code 7, version name `0.2.4-stable+c57e7f5`). A small update to 0.2.3.

### Fixes

- **Frame generation is smooth again when the game runs below half the screen's refresh rate.** The FPS counter used to double, but each generated frame and the real one reached the screen on back-to-back refreshes (about 8 ms apart, then a 25 ms gap), so motion looked no smoother than without frame generation. This was reported on a OnePlus 11 with BeamNG 0.34. Now the frames are shown evenly spaced, for example every 16.7 ms when 30 FPS is doubled to 60 on a 120 Hz screen. Checked for Linux games on Box64 + bionic and FEX + bionic. Windows games with frame generation go through the same code, but were not tested.
- Frame generation now caps the game's own frame rate at the screen's refresh rate divided by the multiplier (60 for 2x on a 120 Hz screen), since the extra frames could not be shown anyway.

Game profiles and the other registry files are read from the tag `v0.2.4` of the components repository (the same content as `v0.2.3`).

### Download and installation

| File | Package |
|---|---|

releases.body:
## SkyNetEmu 0.2.2

Source revision: `48f360d1edca3859f72e447e6943a21ee8eede91` (version code 5, version name `0.2.2-stable+48f360d`).

### Fixes and improvements

**Same game presets on every phone**
- Game presets are no longer limited to particular processors, and the Snapdragon-specific BeamNG Box64 presets are gone. Every phone sees the same presets.
- Presets no longer name a GPU driver; the app picks one for your GPU:
  - Linux games get a Turnip driver when a preset is imported, when a shortcut is created and when a game starts. Adreno 735, 740 and 750 get Mesa Turnip 26.2.2; Adreno 730 gets Turnip v27.0.0 r6; Adreno 8xx keeps its current driver.
  - Windows games get the driver mapped to your GPU when they start, or the system driver when none is mapped.

**Crashes**
- Games no longer crash with SIGSYS on Android versions whose system-call filter refuses calls FEX makes (all FEX + bionic BeamNG starts on a POCO F6 with Android 14 died this way). A refused call now fails normally and is logged to `Winlator/logs/sigsys.log`.
- BeamNG 0.34 now starts on Box64 + bionic without PRoot. It used to crash about a second after start with exit 134 (seen on a OnePlus 11).

releases.name: SkyNetEmu 0.2.1
releases.body:
## SkyNetEmu 0.2.1

Source revision: `e750c469bed4a87644a1dac43ff7e1a137d32120` (version code 4, version name `0.2.1-stable+e750c46`).

### Fixes and improvements

**Counter-Strike 2**
- CS2 starts again on a fresh install. The game stopped with "A game file appears to be missing or corrupted" because its Panorama text library could not load next to the root filesystem's newer HarfBuzz. The app now carries the six small font libraries it needs (unmodified Debian 11 builds of HarfBuzz, FriBidi, libthai, libdatrie, Graphite2 and Pixman) instead of relying on Valve's Steam Linux Runtime 3.0 (sniper) being installed.
- The menu's background videos play from a Steam library on shared storage. The x86-64 and 32-bit x86 shims were missing the `flock` fallback that the aarch64 one already had, so file locks failed on shared storage.

**BeamNG.drive**
- BeamNG 0.39 and 0.40 now offer a single preset: FEX + bionic, no PRoot, direct launch, 960x544. The Box64, Box64 bionic, SoC-specific Box64 and Windows ARM64 presets are removed from those two versions; older BeamNG versions keep theirs.

releases.name: SkyNetEmu 0.2.0
releases.body:
## SkyNetEmu 0.2.0

Source revision: `5e2bcd1806815831a04d18b2b843735200461d0f` (version code 3, version name `0.2.0-stable+5e2bcd1`).

### Fixes and improvements

**Linux games on Android**
- Linux games can run on the bionic FEX without PRoot (direct FEX bridge), with game profiles and presets for BeamNG.drive 0.34, 0.39 and 0.40, Shadow of the Tomb Raider, Rise of the Tomb Raider, Dead Island Definitive Edition, Alien: Isolation and Counter-Strike 2. A Box64 + bionic + no PRoot preset starts BeamNG 0.39 reliably.
- Games run directly from shared storage: FEX retries file mappings that Android's noexec storage refuses, so BeamNG no longer needs staged copies. The old staging code is removed, and its leftover files are deleted when a Linux session starts.
- Steam libraries on shared storage (`SkyNetEmu/Games`): installs work, installed games get shortcuts, and a fresh install finds games that are already downloaded there instead of offering to download them again.
- Tomb Raider (2013, 32-bit) runs from a shared-storage library on the PRoot glibc FEX.
- Android 16: FEX and the shim emulate `openat2` and `faccessat2` (BeamNG exited with SIGSYS).

releases.name: Stella 7.0 released
releases.body:
A new major release of Stella is now available; first time in over two years!  Here are some of the changes:

  * Enhanced ROM launcher to allow multiple images per ROM.

  * Made heaps of additional images available for the ROM launcher.

  * Added searching by filename for ROM launcher images.

  * Added option to start random ROM.

  * Added automatically enabled phosphor modes.

  * Enhanced Game Properties dialog for multigame ROMs.

  * Added 2nd UI theme and hotkey for toggling UI theme.

  * Added bezel support (incl. Sinden Lightgun).

  * Added optional type format detection based on colors used.

  * Added Joy2B+ controller support.

  * Added auto detection for QuadTari attached controllers.

  * Enhanced Kid Vid support to play tape audio.

  * Added port selection, used for controller default mapping.

  * Added missing PlusROM support for E7 bankswitching.

  * Enhanced movie cart (MVC) support.

  * Accelerated emulation up to ~15% (ARM).

  * Added limited GameLine Master Module bankswitching support.

  * Added 03E0 bankswitching for Brazilian Parker Bros ROMs.

  * Added WF8 bankswitching used by some certain Coleco white carts.

  * IMPORTANT NOTES:
    - Because of fixes to JSON handling, all remappings will be reset to defaults; if you had custom mappings, they will need to be re-entered again.
    - Because of internal changes, all state files are now invalid.

  * Completely reworked the file launcher:
    - Redesigned user interface
    - Added tracking of user favorites, recently played and most popular games
    - Added virtual directories for selecting tracked games
    - Added quick path navigation
    - Added navigation history
    - Added icons for files and directories
    - Added option to show/hide file extensions
    - Extended context menu and shortcuts
    - Fixed sluggish behaviour when reading large and/or invalid files

  * Added hotkey display to tooltips.

  * Added option to automatically pause emulation when focus is lost.

  * Added option to toggle autofire mode.

  * Improved controller mappings for Paddles.

  * Improved controller mappings for Driving controllers.

  * Improved Mindlink support.

  * Added another oddball TIA glitch option for score mode color.

  * Enhanced TV jitter emulation.

releases.body:
## Somniel v0.1.7a

**A small update: a way to save a log of what went wrong, so crashes and loading-screen hangs can be tracked down.**

### New
- **Save diagnostic log.** A new row in the sidebar's main page saves the game's log to `Downloads/somniel_logs` in one
  tap. Do this before closing the game if it is stuck or misbehaving.
- **Asks to save the log after a crash or freeze.** When the game is opened again after it crashed or stopped
  responding (not after you simply swiped it away), it asks whether to save the log of that run to the same folder.
  Choose *Save log*; nothing is sent anywhere, the file just waits in your Downloads folder.
- The audio-failure log from v0.1.7 now goes to the same `somniel_logs` folder (it used to be `Somniel_log`).

### Bug reports
From now on **every crash or hang report needs the saved log attached** (the `.txt` from `Downloads/somniel_logs`).
Without it there is usually no way to tell what happened on a GPU we cannot test.

### Download
`Somniel-0.1.7a.apk` (6.4 MB)

releases.body:
## Somniel v0.1.7

**Save export, customisable on-screen controls, dynamic resolution, Skip intro, a redesigned sidebar, and a fix for
missing sound.**

### New
- **Export saves.** The sidebar's *Import / Export Saves...* (was *Import saves...*) can now also export: all your saves
  go into one `.zip` wherever you choose, and the game keeps running. The file is checked after it is written, and it
  imports again as it is.
- **Customisable on-screen controls** (sidebar, *On-screen controls*):
  - **Size** (50% to 150%) and **Opacity** (20% to 100%) sliders.
  - **Edit layout**: drag any control (left stick, D-pad, right stick, A/B/X/Y, Minus/Plus, ZL/L, R/ZR) to where it
    suits you, tap one and use *Smaller* / *Bigger* to resize just that one, *Reset* for one or all. Back finishes.
  - **Reset layout** puts every control back (size and opacity are kept). Layouts are saved on the device.
- **Dynamic resolution** (on by default, checkbox under the render scale): when frames keep missing your frame rate,
  the resolution steps down in 5% steps, at most 20% below the render scale you chose, and climbs back when there is
  room again. It never goes above your choice.

## Somniel v0.1.6

**Dynamic game speed, a redesigned on-screen gamepad, and better telemetry.**

### New
- **Dynamic game speed.** The game's speed now follows the frame rate you actually get, so walking, cursor and game time
  stay at normal speed when your device dips below the frame rate you chose. It scales down to a floor of 20 fps.
  Applies to the hub walk speed, world-map walking and all per-frame game logic.
- **Redesigned on-screen gamepad** (phones).

### Improved
- **Telemetry** (only if you opted in to Share anonymous data): hitch reports now include a coarse reason for each slow
  frame, and time spent in the background is no longer counted. Still no names, accounts, IPs, paths or saves.

### Upgrading
- Install over your existing copy (or use **Check for updates**). **Do not uninstall first**, or you lose your game
  data and saves.
- Same signing key as earlier versions, so it updates normally.

releases.body:
## Somniel v0.1.4

**A smoother Somniel on Mali GPUs, far fewer stutters, and a working anti-aliasing switch.**

### New
- **Hidden object culling** (Graphics page): skips objects that are completely hidden behind walls. On a Dimensity 7300 (Mali-G615 MC2) the
  Somniel shops went from about 25 fps to a steady 29–30 fps. **Auto** (the default)
  turns it on for Mali GPUs only, because it made a Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 (Adreno 740) slower in testing.

### Fixed
- **Stutters while walking around the Somniel.** Shaders the game had already prepared were being prepared again,
  causing pauses of up to half a second. Walking the Somniel Plaza now has no pause longer than about 50 ms.
  This is repaired automatically the first time you start v0.1.4.
- **Anti-aliasing Off now works in the Somniel.** Before, it only took effect on the battle map. Turning it off gives
  about 2 fps more in busy spots on Mali GPUs.

### Upgrading
- Install over your existing copy. **Do not uninstall first**, or you lose your game data and saves.
- Same signing key as earlier versions, so it updates normally.

### Download

releases.name: BioShock Classic for Android v0.3-dev
releases.body:
Development release of the experimental Android ARM64 port of BioShock Classic. Changes since v0.2.1-dev.

## Saves and stability

- Save files are written to a temporary file, validated, synchronized and atomically committed after the last handle closes. Write, sync and rename errors reach the game; failed temporary files are retained for possible recovery.
- Existing saves are validated before enumeration. Damaged files are omitted and quarantined under `SaveGames/damaged/`, fixing the main-menu crash path caused by an interrupted save. Checks cover headers, PNG thumbnails, metadata and zlib packages. This does not repair damaged save data.
- Added a workaround for device loss in high-quality bloom passes on Adreno 650 with the bundled Turnip driver reporting Vulkan API 1.3.335.

## Performance and rendering

- Optimized static index buffers, occlusion query batching, query reset and nonblocking result reads, and deferred offscreen clears on PanVK / Mali-G76 MC4. Automatic enablement is restricted to the measured GPU model.
- Updated bundled PanVK with deferred occlusion availability for Bifrost v7, command batch cleanup fixes and allocation error handling.

releases.name: BioShock Classic for Android v0.2.1-dev
releases.body:
Development release of the experimental Android ARM64 port of BioShock Classic. Changes since v0.2-dev:

## Changes and fixes

- Added crash reports with a copy-to-clipboard button. Reports are saved under `BioShock/crashes` and include the game log, build information and available native crash details. Crash monitoring can be disabled in the launcher.
- Fixed a buffer overflow when taking research-camera photos. Vulkan and OpenGL ES now respect the source and destination regions and resize the captured image to 256 x 256.
- Added movement-stick settings for the dead zone, visibility and fixed position.

releases.name: BioShock Classic for Android v0.2-dev
releases.body:
Development release of the experimental Android ARM64 port of BioShock Classic. Changes since v0.1.1-dev:

## Performance and rendering

- Moved Vulkan pipeline and OpenGL ES program warm-up to low-priority background workers, with a larger seed recorded across all 15 levels. Cached results are reused on later starts.
- Reduced loading stalls through fairer thread handoffs, background logging and memory cleanup, texture read-ahead, and caching repeated missing-file checks.
- Removed redundant Vulkan buffer bindings and OpenGL ES state changes. Fixed compressed-texture uploads and preserved the aspect ratio when changing render resolution.
- Fixed first-person weapon and arm framing on wide screens while preserving world FOV, weapon FOV, and zoom settings.
- Updated bundled PanVK; compatible Mali devices can now use it on Android 11 or later. Added an Adreno 618 workaround for GPU loss with bundled Turnip.
- Renderer startup failures and device/context loss now return to the launcher with a reason and an offer to select another renderer.
- ADPF is now off by default.

## Controls and interface

releases.name: BioShock Classic for Android v0.1.1-dev
releases.body:
Second development release of the experimental Android ARM64 port of BioShock Classic.

## Controls and interface

- Added iPhone and iPad touch layouts alongside the port layout and a hidden-controls mode. The iOS layouts use 52 original sprites, including eight weapon icons and 22 plasmid icons. They show the equipped weapon and plasmid, the active slot, crouch or stand state, and the alternate reload icon in plasmid mode.
- Added a 50–200% iOS control scale and context-sensitive Hack, Rescue, and Harvest buttons. Control groups scale together and the left group accounts for the health and ammo HUD. Map and Pause activate on release over the same button.
- Kept movement and camera gestures available with the overlay hidden. Fixed absolute touch coordinates at screen edges and input recovery after graphics changes or a stalled input event.
- Added phone vibration for in-game rumble and touch feedback, with an on/off switch and strength adjustment in 25% steps.
- Added optional touch aim assist using BioShock's controller aim system. Each touch sample is consumed once, and direct touch look remains available when the game's aim properties are unavailable.

releases.name: BioShock Classic for Android v0.1-dev
releases.body:
First development release of the experimental Android ARM64 port of BioShock Classic. The port uses ahead-of-time recompilation of the original Windows x86 code.

## Features

- OpenGL ES 3.2 and Vulkan rendering, with bundled Turnip and PanVK options for compatible GPUs.
- Touch controls, gamepad input, and configurable controls.
- Launcher with folder and ZIP game-data import, renderer selection, optional texture conversion, and update checks.

## Requirements and installation

- An ARM64 Android device running Android 8.0 or later. OpenGL ES 3.2 is the default renderer. See the repository README for Vulkan and driver requirements.
- Your own installation of **BioShock Classic for Windows, patch 1.1, GOG build 127339**. The original game files are required separately.
- Sideload the APK. Copy your Classic game folder to the device with its `Builds/` and `Content/` directories, then select that folder under **Game data** in the launcher and press **Play**.

## Known limitations

Device, driver, and full-campaign testing is limited in this development release.

## Saves and stability

- Save files are written to a temporary file, validated, synchronized and atomically committed after the last handle closes. Write, sync and rename errors reach the game; failed temporary files are retained for possible recovery.

releases.body:
> [!WARNING]
> **How far this was tested.** The changes in 1.01 were built and checked on a PC, but have not been played on a phone yet. Expect problems, and please report them with a debug report (☰ → Bug reports → Make a debug report).

Install it over 1.0 or older. Your saves and settings stay. **Setup runs again once after updating**: the shaders change, so the app rebuilds them before Play.

Everything here applies to both Pokémon Scarlet and Pokémon Violet (update 4.0.0).

---

## Fixed

- **Missing buildings, ground, rocks, walls, trees and furniture**: objects the game culls on the GPU were all drawn in the same spot, so many of them never appeared. They should now show up on every GPU.
- **Ground missing on older Adreno drivers** (sky visible through the terrain, seen on an Adreno 730): a vertex workaround meant for Mali now runs only on Mali by default.

## Known problems

- **Untested on a phone** (see above).
- **Crashes with "device lost" on Adreno** (at character creation, after picking a starter, or after a loading screen): reported on several phones and being looked into. A debug report from the moment it happens helps a lot.

releases.body:
> [!WARNING]
> **How far this was tested.** Everything new in 1.0 was built and checked on a PC (including simulated Mali, Adreno, Xclipse and PowerVR GPUs), but has not been played on a phone yet. Expect problems, and please report them with a debug report (☰ → Bug reports → Make a debug report).

Install it over v0.99 or older. Your saves, settings and setup stay. **No new setup is needed**: just press Play.

Everything here applies to both Pokémon Scarlet and Pokémon Violet (update 4.0.0).

---

## Fixed: a possible crash at start in v0.99

- A diagnostic that sampled the game during loads could break the game's code and close it (it did so in Legends: Arceus v0.99). It is now off by default and made safe. If you added `DM_LOAD_PROF=0` to env.txt, you can remove it.

## New in 1.0

- **Less work for the GPU**: fewer drawing passes per frame (clears are folded into the next pass, empty depth passes are gone) and depth and stencil that a pass does not change are no longer written back to memory. This helps most on Mali and older Adreno phones. If objects go missing or flicker after updating, add `DM_VK_LAZY_CLEAR=0` to env.txt and tell us in an issue.

## From v0.99

> **How far this was tested.** Everything below was built and checked on a PC; the crash fixes and the speed work have not been played on a phone with Scarlet or Violet yet. Expect problems, and please report them (see the end of these notes).

Install it over v0.98 or v0.96. Your saves, settings and setup stay. **No new setup is needed**: just press Play.

Everything here applies to both Pokémon Scarlet and Pokémon Violet (one app runs both, update 4.0.0).

---

## Crash fixes

- **A graphics driver that crashes on one shader no longer stops the game from starting.** Some phones' own Qualcomm drivers (seen on a Galaxy Z Fold4, Adreno 730) crashed while preparing one of the game's shaders, at every start. The game now remembers the shader that crashed the driver and leaves it out from the next start on. Something small may be missing from the picture then; it may take one or two more crashes before the game gets through.
- **Turnip: the crash right after making your character** (when the ID photo is taken) should be fixed: the photo is now copied in a way that driver handles.
